failures.expected_behavior: Nominal coverage >= 95% achieved without expanding uncertainty interval width.
failures.observed_behavior: Model H achieved 95.02% nominal coverage, but mean interval width increased by 8.5% (0.2076m vs 0.1913m), and 24.28% of cases exceeded the 0.25m autonomous threshold.
failures.safety_impact: LOW (MITIGATED): Elevated uncertainty cases are safely downgraded to ADVISORY_ONLY by action policy.
failures.mitigation: Action-gating policy enforces ADVISORY_ONLY on widths between 0.25m and 0.40m.

failures.expected_behavior: Independent external facility validation data available for multi-facility generalization testing.
failures.observed_behavior: External facility footage remains physically unavailable due to pending site sensor acquisition.
failures.safety_impact: MEDIUM: Multi-facility generalization cannot be claimed; system restricted to Facility Central 01.
failures.mitigation: Operational pilot strictly restricted to Facility Central 01 sector architecture.

failures.expected_behavior: Broad population-level causal backfire frequency distribution established across facilities.
failures.observed_behavior: Sample size is N=6 discrete case studies (1 PHYSICAL_NEW), which prevents population-level statistical frequency inference.
failures.safety_impact: LOW: System refrains from claiming generalized causal effect distributions.
failures.mitigation: Claims strictly limited to discrete case studies; population inference prohibited.
